name: Bowmaster
summary:
Dust off your double bow skills in Bowmaster Early Access, a target treadmill that feeds you as many flying target as you can handle. Benchmark your bow skill. Earn skill belts by completing different difficulties and patterns. 

Start honing your skills to prepare for what's coming in future releases and secure your advantage over players waiting for a full-polish build. Early access players will get a rare in-game cosmetic for supporting Bowmaster in its earliest form.
